topics.title: WebRTC Video/Audio Peer Connections & SFU Architecture
topics.objective: Establish low-latency, end-to-end encrypted clinical video calls using Selective Forwarding Units.
topics.exercise: Set up a WebRTC video consultation room with media stream quality adaptation under packet loss.

topics.title: Virtual Waiting Rooms & Dynamic Clinician Routing
topics.objective: Manage patient digital queues and alert clinicians when scheduled patients check into the consultation session.
topics.exercise: Build a WebSocket waiting room notifying doctors when a patient completes pre-call audio/video verification.

topics.title: Cryptographically Signed e-Prescriptions
topics.objective: Generate tamper-evident, digitally signed medical prescriptions compliant with pharmacy dispensing standards.
topics.exercise: Implement an e-prescription PDF generator embedding a verifiable cryptographic signature and QR code.

topics.title: Clinical Charting & FHIR Protocol Synchronization
topics.objective: Export consultation encounter notes into hospital EHR systems via standard HL7/FHIR resources.
topics.exercise: Map video call encounter notes to a FHIR Encounter resource and transmit it to an external EHR sandbox.

topics.title: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Device Telemetry
topics.objective: Ingest live biometric data (blood pressure, pulse oximetry, glucose) and trigger clinical alerts.
topics.example: if (vitals.spO2 < 90) { alertOnCallClinician('Hypoxia alert for patient: ' + patientId); }
topics.exercise: Write an ingestion endpoint for Bluetooth pulse oximeter data triggering urgent clinician notifications on anomalies.
